svg.title: Field Recordings, Great Salt Lake LP

g.text: VISIT SALT LAKE · MERCH ROUND 1 · LANE 3 OBJECTS · PIECE 02
12-inch LP. Sounds of the lake, the lift, snow on a windshield. The Spiral Jetty is the label. Pressed in split pink and teal vinyl.
sounds of the lake, the lift,

svg.text: SLEEVE FRONT · 12.25 IN, REVERSE BOARD · DISC: 180 G SPLIT-COLOR VINYL
SLEEVE BACK · TRACKLIST, LIVE RECORDINGS, NO OVERDUBS

g.text: Wind across the north arm, Rozel Point, before sunrise
Wildcat lift, Alta. Sheave wheels in the bottom terminal
Snow on a windshield, I-80 westbound, wipers off
Brush, scraper, cold start. 6:10 a.m., Sugar House driveway
TRAX Blue Line doors and chimes, Gallivan Plaza platform
Avalanche control, Little Cottonwood Canyon, road closed
Brine flies lifting off the shoreline, Antelope Island
Wind through the Saltair pavilion, west of the airport
Gulls over the railroad causeway, trains crossing
Salt crust underfoot, Spiral Jetty at low water
Recorded on location, winter. Stereo, no overdubs.
Recorded by: ____________________ (recordist named on every pressing)
Label after Robert Smithson, Spiral Jetty, 1970. Holt/Smithson Foundation.
Visit Salt Lake · VSL 001 · 40.7608° N 111.8910° W
Split-color pour: Salt Pink north arm over Sky south arm,
the seam set at the causeway angle. Each disc pours differently,
Label: 100 mm uncoated cream, the jetty printed counter-clockwise
as built, one color, Ink. Side B label is the same spiral at low water,
Jacket: 12.25 in reverse-board, uncoated, Salt Pink flood with
Ink spiral, the jetty's arm running off the top edge. Poly-lined
inner sleeve. Download card is a 4 × 6 in postcard of the north arm.
Sleeve type: Saans Medium tracked caps (eyebrow) and Ivar Italic
for the contents line. Tracklist in a monospace. No logo on the front.
Front spiral: 8.5 in across, centered low
